resolution.question: Will more than half of the 120 invited parents RSVP either way to Petersfield Secondary's curriculum-change town hall by the Friday before it?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that more than 60 distinct parents (i.e., more than half of 120) have sent an RSVP (either 'yes' or 'no') to the school before the Friday before the town hall (i.e., before 2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff (2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00) if the Friday before the town hall has passed by then, or at the end of that Friday if it falls before the cutoff.
